## `get_user_prompt_by_name`

*Available in [Python](#get_user_prompt_by_name-python)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Gets a user prompt (stored in the 'resources/templates/user_prompts/' directory) as a string
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    get_user_prompt_by_name(
        name
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `name` (`str`) - The name of the template to retrieve.

    <h4>Returns `str`</h4>
